objective: Evidence-first P0 delivery of verified Kompas Pro, original W46 forecast, source integrity, nonbinding analyst scenarios and scientific honesty.

lanes.name: Source and current authority
lanes.question: Does official currentness survive original packet and pointer checks?
lanes.hypothesis: Check source clocks and actual source-to-official ancestry before blaming the model.
lanes.baseline: A pointer can be timely while original observation is stale.
lanes.falsifier: A fresh issue with stale first-known/source window is inadmissible.

lanes.name: Monday seven-day original issuance
lanes.question: Can W46 issue genuinely independent daily prices and extrema before outcomes?
lanes.hypothesis: Audit original W46 publisher and consumer with identical UTC and quote metadata.
lanes.baseline: W45 original weekly envelope and its documented 0/7 path.
lanes.falsifier: Absent real 7/7 or cross-quote mismatch disproves production readiness.

lanes.name: Numeric forward-price model custody
lanes.question: Which 1-56d original forecast candidates have admissible producer and source clocks?
lanes.hypothesis: Separate already admitted numeric issues from research preflight and abstention.
lanes.baseline: Price-only and volatility-only baseline under matching observation clocks.
lanes.falsifier: No independent original issue proves advanced model readiness.

lanes.name: Long-range macro conditional scenarios
lanes.question: Can multi-month BTC macro scenarios be more informative than volatility extrapolation?
lanes.hypothesis: Require distinct macro-cycle assumptions and falsifiers for 1-12m.
lanes.baseline: No-skill conditional scenario and volatility-only research baseline.
lanes.falsifier: No testable driver or independent cohort leaves numeric maturity unproven.

lanes.name: Pullback and rotation warning utility
lanes.question: Are pullback level changes timely compared with simple HOLD and price-only risk?
lanes.hypothesis: Measure lead time, false alarms, microcap impact and no SELL promotion.
lanes.baseline: Frozen W45 elevated risk and independent price-only pullback baseline.
lanes.falsifier: Nonincremental warning lead or unacceptable false positives rejects upgrade.

lanes.name: Point in time scientific accountability
lanes.question: Does any available model improve on matched price-only and persistence comparators?
lanes.hypothesis: Use immutable original issue time, matured horizons and non-overlapping controls.
lanes.baseline: No-skill persistence and same-clock B1 price-only controls.
lanes.falsifier: No independent maturation or width-adjusted lift disproves an edge claim.

lanes.name: Premium chat and site consumer integrity
lanes.question: Can verified official actions coexist with explicit nonbinding analyst price scenarios?
lanes.hypothesis: Ship a strict 14-horizon chat-only presentation boundary without new issuer.
lanes.baseline: Existing status-only 14 horizon readback and stale all-WAIT failure mode.
lanes.falsifier: A fake official price, stale action or missing asset row fails the consumer.

lanes.name: Release reliability and closure controls
lanes.question: Which current PRs are actually merge-qualified without violating recovery or source gates?
lanes.hypothesis: Prioritize original-owner source repairs, exact-head CI and real main readback.
lanes.baseline: Current draft and unresolved recovery-gated PR queue.
lanes.falsifier: Missing required original CI or independent custody blocks release.
